title: Ex Vivo Mouse Kidney Slice Experiment
author: Wakana Shoda
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.baf9ibr6

steps.title: Make abdominal incision and expose kidney
steps.instruction: Use round‑side scissors to cut the skin from bottom to top along the abdominal line, then cut the lateral skin to free the abdomen. Displace the intestine to the right with a finger to visualize the kidney. Clip the sternum with curved forceps, cut the ribs without damaging the lungs, and move the forceps to give access to the beating heart.

substeps.instruction: Cut skin along abdominal line with round‑side scissors.
Cut lateral skin for abdominal access.
Displace intestine to the right to see kidney.

steps.title: Insert needle into right ventricle
steps.instruction: Pick up a 22‑gauge needle and insert it through the right ventricle of the heart.

steps.title: Perfuse kidney with oxygenated HBSS
steps.instruction: Cut the right auricle and begin perfusion at 17 mL min⁻¹ using Hank's balanced salt solution (HBSS) pH 7.4, pre‑warmed to 37 °C and equilibrated with 5 % CO₂ / 95 % O₂. Continue perfusion until the kidneys become clear of blood and appear green‑white.

substeps.instruction: Perfuse at 17 mL min⁻¹ with HBSS (pH 7.4, 37 °C, 5 % CO₂/95 % O₂).
Perfuse until kidneys are blood‑free and turn green‑white.

steps.title: Remove kidneys and dissect into pieces
steps.instruction: Immediately remove the kidneys, strip off the capsule, and cut each kidney into pieces 3–5 mm thick.

steps.title: Slice kidney pieces to 0.5 mm
steps.instruction: Place the 3–5 mm pieces in bubbling buffer at room temperature and, using a Natume Seisakusho micro‑slicer, cut from cortex to papilla into approximately 0.5 mm thick slices, taking care to avoid tissue damage.

substeps.instruction: Keep pieces in bubbling buffer at room temperature.
Slice with Natume Seisakusho micro‑slicer to ~0.5 mm thickness from cortex to papilla.

steps.title: Recover slices in HBSS
steps.instruction: Incubate the slices at room temperature for 20 min in equilibrated HBSS while maintaining bubbling; ensure the tissue remains immersed at all times.

steps.title: Prepare drug solution in vial
steps.instruction: Hold a tube inside a 20 mL scintillation vial and add 10 mL of drug solution (minimum 3 mL) to the vial.

steps.title: Treat slices with drug
steps.instruction: Transfer the slices into the drug solution and keep them in bubbling buffer at room temperature for the desired treatment period.

steps.title: Snap‑freeze slices
steps.instruction: After treatment, immediately snap‑freeze the slices in liquid nitrogen.
